messages.subject: OR-425 datasheet revision B (ORS-DS-0425-B)
messages.snippet: Dear installer,  Revision B of the OR-425 datasheet (ORS-DS-0425-B, 18 March 2026) is now in your datasheet library. Changes from revision A
messages.body:
Dear installer,

Revision B of the OR-425 datasheet (ORS-DS-0425-B, 18 March 2026) is now in your datasheet library. Changes from revision A: mechanical drawing updated, connector type, warranty text. Electrical data unchanged.

Orrin Solar Technologies — Technical Services

messages.subject: LM-455 revision B published — supersedes revision A
messages.snippet: Hello,  Lumen Photovoltaic has published revision B of the LM-455 datasheet (LPV-455-DS-B, 2 September 2026). STC data are re-stated from se
messages.body:
Hello,

Lumen Photovoltaic has published revision B of the LM-455 datasheet (LPV-455-DS-B, 2 September 2026). STC data are re-stated from series production: Voc 41.30 V, Voc coefficient -0.27 %/°C. Revision A (pre-production samples) is superseded.

Lumen Datasheet Service

messages.body:
Kestrel installer bulletin Q4 2026

- KP-470 stock is plentiful at Kerrow (Redruth).
- Reminder: Kestrel datasheets state some temperature coefficients in absolute units per module; check the unit column on the datasheet.
- Warranty registration moves to the new portal on 1 December.

Kestrel Photonics Partner Team

messages.subject: CV-440B bifacial — rear-side gain note
messages.snippet: Corvane note for designers: CV-440B rear-side gain is not to be added to Isc for string sizing on pitched residential roofs (gain below 3%).
messages.body:
Corvane note for designers: CV-440B rear-side gain is not to be added to Isc for string sizing on pitched residential roofs (gain below 3%). Datasheet revision B governs.

Corvane Energy
